site_text: Two revised owner-ambiguity examples passed independent model review, preserving four existing record instances. The original formal run was stopped in a controlled manner after 13 completed optimizer updates, covering 208 training rows, following sustained throughput decline. The cause remains unconfirmed. The earlier running milestone and original run records are preserved. A candidate memory-management amendment is planned and awaits separate validation. No test inference was performed; tracking-quality results remain unavailable.
